phrases: 表示在某事发生的时候
At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling.
谋杀发生时，我正在旅行。
表示正在乘坐（某种交通工具）
I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train.
I must catch the early train to work.
我必须赶上早班火车去上班。
I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
I bought a paper and waited for the train.
表示注意到任何不寻常的事
Did you notice anything unusual at the station?
你在车站注意到什么不寻常的事了吗？
You are not telling the truth.
表示停止运营；取消（线路）
The train was taken off the line.
I suggest that you are not telling the truth.
Would a later train get you to work on time?
晚一点的火车能让你准时到公司吗？

grammar.f: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing + 时间状语
grammar.d: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在发生的行为，常与at the time, when等连用
ex: At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train.
谋杀发生时，我正乘坐8点的火车。
What were you doing at 8 o'clock yesterday?

grammar.k: 一般过去时 vs 过去进行时
grammar.f:
一般过去时：主语 + 动词过去式
过去进行时：主语 + was/were + 动词-ing
grammar.d: 一般过去时表示过去完成的动作；过去进行时表示过去正在进行的动作 当一个过去进行的动作被另一个过去的动作（一般过去时）打断时，常用过去进行时描述较长的背景动作
ex: I was waiting for the train when it arrived.
火车来的时候我正在等它。
While I was travelling, the murder happened.
当我旅行时，谋杀发生了。

grammar.k: 宾语从句 (Object Clause) - I suggest that...
grammar.f: 主语 + suggest/believe/think + that + 主语 + 动词...
grammar.d: that引导的宾语从句，用于表达观点、建议或暗示 suggest后面接that从句，表示暗示或建议某事为真
ex: I suggest that you are not telling the truth.
I suggest that he caught the 8.25 train.
我暗示他赶上了8:25的火车。

patterns.p: At the time..., 主语 + was/were + doing...
o: At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train.
谋杀发生时，我正乘坐8点的火车。
im: At the time the accident happened, I was sleeping.
事故发生时，我正在睡觉。
At the time I called you, he was having dinner.
我给你打电话时，他正在吃晚饭。

patterns.p: Do you always + 动词原形...?
o: Do you always catch such an early train?
你总是赶这么早的火车吗？
im: Do you always get up so early?
Do you always have breakfast at home?

patterns.p: Would + 主语 + 动词原形 + get you to + 地点...?
o: Would a later train get you to work on time?
晚一点的火车能让你准时到公司吗？
im: Would a taxi get you to the airport on time?
出租车能让你准时到机场吗？
Would walking get you home before dark?
走路能让你在天黑前到家吗？

patterns.p: I suggest that + 主语 + 动词...
o: I suggest that you are not telling the truth.
im: I suggest that he was at the scene of the crime.
I suggest that she knows more than she says.
我暗示她知道的比她说的多。
